ex.t: 我家在农场摘杏仁已经有四十年了。

ex.t: 跑步是大城市私立学校富家子弟的事，不是我们这些穷农家孩子的事。

ex.t: 在鸡舍和其他家畜栏舍周围安装电围栏，对驱赶灰熊也非常有效。

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往大同小异，不是农田就是公路，但有时我会在丘陵或湖泊中发现独特的韵味。

ex.s: Over the past few years, many solar farm developers have transformed the space under their solar panels into a shelter for various kinds of pollinators, resulting in soil improvement and carbon reduction.
ex.t: 过去几年里，许多太阳能农场开发商把太阳能板下的空间改造成了各种传粉昆虫的庇护所，从而改善了土壤并减少了碳排放。

ex.s: I was invited to a cookout on an old friend’s farm in western Washington.
ex.t: 我被邀请到西华盛顿一位老朋友的农场参加户外烧烤。

ex.s: I parked my car outside the farm and walked past a milking house which had apparently not been used in many years.
ex.t: 我把车停在农场外，走过一间显然多年未用的挤奶房。

ex.s: A few weeks later, I went to the farm again.
ex.t: 几周后，我再次去了那个农场。

ex.s: Mauer, of Edgar, Wisconsin, grew up on a farm in a family of 10 children.
ex.t: 毛尔来自威斯康星州埃德加，在一个有10个孩子的家庭里、在农场长大。

ex.s: Her dad worked at a job away from the farm, and her mother ran the farm with the kids.
ex.t: 她父亲在农场以外的地方工作，母亲和孩子们一起经营农场。

ex.s: She ran the family farm on her own.
ex.t: 她独自经营着家庭农场。

ex.s: Uncle Paul, my dad’s friend, picked us up from the airport and drove us up to his farm in Pecos.
ex.t: 爸爸的朋友保罗叔叔从机场接上我们，开车送我们到了他在佩科斯的农场。

ex.s: "The day starts at dawn on my farm," he said.
ex.t: 下午，我问叔叔保罗我是否可以骑马，他说可以，只要爸爸跟我一起去。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: 3D Food Printing： From Farm to Table
ex.t: D．3D食物打印：从农场到餐桌
